instruction: In xarray/core/formatting.py, make coords_repr list the coordinates in dimension order. Right before its "return _mapping_repr(" line add: "dims = tuple(coords._data.dims)" and then "dim_ordered_coords = sorted(", the line "coords.items(), key=lambda x: dims.index(x[0]) if x[0] in dims else len(dims)" indented one level deeper, and ")". Then pass "dict(dim_ordered_coords)," instead of "coords," as the first argument of _mapping_repr.
